title: 第十一章 十年五境第十二章 风雪折梅
lines: 神海中，响起女子的声音：“肉身五境，炼筋、锻骨、换血、通窍、聚灵。”
“不仅是增强你的肉身，还能磨砺你的神魂。”
“十年，希望你能二年破一境，只有这样，你才有可能在某一天，面对世间的危机......”
王贤深吸一口气，回道：“前辈放心，我要给师父一个惊喜！”
第一年，王贤根本没有时间去感悟三千大道。
石阶上的寒风如刀一样割在他的身上，加上十倍重力，将他浑身上下割得鲜血淋漓。
就在他肉身将要崩溃之际，烙印血肉之中的道经化为金光，将他撕裂的肉身快速修复。
踏上二百级石阶，肉身无惧如刀的寒风之时，已经苦修了二年。
第三年，重力来到十三倍。
就像他初次踏上石阶之时，再次感受了恐怖的威压。
而这时的重压就像是一把神锤，无情地敲在王贤的身上......一次又一次倒下，全身的骨骼尽碎。
在重压之下，王贤的骨头一次次地愈合，道经从他的血内，往全身的骨髓烙印。
又花了二年，王贤从石阶上站了起来，踏上了五百级石阶。
第五年，呜呜的寒风化为神龙，龙爪一次次地将王贤的肉身撕裂，无视他的铜筋、铁骨。
一声剑鸣自他神海深处响起，斩向风中的神龙......
一时间金血漫天，流尽最后一滴血的王贤笑了。
放开双手，去拥抱如刀和寒风，跟眼前这头垂死的神龙。
第六年，王贤来到了第八百级石阶，在如针刺一样的寒风和重力之下，整整花了一年的苦修。
在生不如死的折磨之下，打通了身体的七窍。
第七年，三千石阶在王贤眼里变成了一座巨大的阵法。
他要在这里用肉身，而不是丹田去将天地灵气，化为肉身之力。
还要试着跟天地间的大阵，融为一体......
这一年，苦练之下的王贤已经恍若疯癫之状！
直到他将天地间的一丝灵气炼化为肉身之力，直到寒风中已经看不出王贤身影之时。
他已经站在了一千五百级石阶之上。
剩下的三年，一边打磨肉身，一边感悟三千大道。
整整三年，王贤将七年的感慨，连着脚下的石阶，试着去领悟不可琢磨的时间之力。
一丝空间之力！
哪怕只是恍然间感悟，也让他惊喜不已！
花了整整三年，终于，他在踏上最后一级石阶之际，恍若看到了他在二百级石阶上的身影。
或者说，他直接从二千八百级石阶之上。
只是踏出一步，便如若穿越一片折叠空间，来到了雪山之巅，来到了青衣女子面前。
十年五境，应该说不止五境。
当下的王贤，花了十年的苦修，将自己的心境打磨得比之前更为沉稳。
趴在雪地里，王贤给面前的女子磕了三个头。
喃喃自语道：“我没见过母亲的模样，前辈你给我的感觉，就像母亲。”
女子闻言，只觉心口一痛。
摸着他的脑袋幽幽说道：“十年五境，你果然没让我失望，神剑藏在你的神海，不到化神之上，你无法使用......”
王贤问道：“前辈你要走了吗？我以后去哪里找你？”
女子挥手之间，天空的寒风渐歇，露出遥远的星河。
望向天边。
却温柔说道：“总有一天，你会踏上诸天，我们自然还会有重逢的一刻！”
王贤点了点头。
女子幽幽一叹：“此间十年，外面的世界不过十天而已，切记，不要将此间发生的一切，告诉任何人。”
content_en:
In the divine sea, a woman's voice sounded: "The five realms of the physical body are muscle strengthening, bone forging, blood exchange, orifice opening, and spirit gathering."
"It not only strengthens your physical body, but also sharpens your spirit."
"In ten years, I hope you can break through a realm in two years. Only in this way will you be able to face the crisis in the world one day..."
Wang Xian took a deep breath and replied: "Senior, don't worry, I want to give Master a surprise!"
In the first year, Wang Xian had no time to comprehend the three thousand avenues.
The cold wind on the stone steps cut into his body like a knife, and with ten times the gravity, blood dripped from his body.
Just when his body was about to collapse, the Taoist scriptures imprinted in his flesh and blood turned into golden light, quickly repairing his torn body.
When I stepped onto the 200 stone steps, my body was not afraid of the cold wind like a knife, I had been practicing hard for two years.
In the third year, gravity reaches thirteen times.
Just like when he first stepped onto the stone steps, he felt the terrifying pressure again.
And the heavy pressure at this time was like a magic hammer, hitting Wang Xian mercilessly... He fell down again and again, and all the bones in his body were broken.
Under the heavy pressure, Wang Xian's bones healed again and again, and Taoist scriptures were imprinted from his blood to the bone marrow of his body.
After another two years, Wang Xian stood up from the stone steps and stepped on the 500 stone steps.
In the fifth year, the howling cold wind turned into a divine dragon, and the dragon's claws tore Wang Xian's body apart again and again, ignoring his copper tendons and iron bones.
"Zheng!"
A sword cry sounded from the depths of his divine sea, slashing at the dragon in the wind...
For a moment, the sky was filled with gold and blood, and Wang Xian, who had shed the last drop of blood, smiled.
Let go of your hands and embrace Rudao and Hanfeng, as well as the dying dragon in front of you.
In the sixth year, Wang Xian reached the 800th stone step and spent a full year of hard training under the cold wind and gravity like needles.
Under the torture that was worse than death, the seven orifices of the body were opened.
In the seventh year, the three thousand stone steps turned into a huge formation in Wang Xian's eyes.
He wants to use his physical body here instead of his Dantian to turn the spiritual energy of heaven and earth into the power of the physical body.
Also try to integrate with the great formation between heaven and earth...
This year, Wang Xian, who has been practicing hard, has become crazy!
Until he refined a trace of spiritual energy between heaven and earth into physical power, until Wang Xian's figure could no longer be seen in the cold wind.
He was already standing on the fifteen hundred stone steps.
In the remaining three years, while polishing the physical body, I also comprehended the three thousand avenues.
For three whole years, Wang Xian connected the seven years of emotion to the stone steps under his feet, trying to understand the incomprehensible power of time.
A trace of space power!
Even if he just suddenly realized it, he was pleasantly surprised!
It took three full years, but finally, when he stepped onto the last stone step, he suddenly saw his figure on the two hundred stone steps.
In other words, he went directly from the 2,800 stone steps.
Just taking one step, it was like traveling through a folded space, arriving at the top of the snow mountain, and in front of the woman in green.
Ten years and five realms, it should be said that there are more than five realms.
The current Wang Xian has spent ten years of hard training to polish his state of mind to be more stable than before.
Lying in the snow, Wang Xian kowtowed three times to the woman in front of him.
He murmured to himself: "I have never seen my mother's appearance. Senior, you make me feel like a mother."
When the woman heard this, she felt a pain in her heart.
Touching his head, he said faintly: "Ten years and five realms, you really did not disappoint me. The divine sword is hidden in your divine sea. You cannot use it unless you are above the transformed spirit..."
Wang Xian asked: "Senior, are you leaving? Where should I find you in the future?"
As the woman waved her hands, the cold wind in the sky gradually subsided, revealing the distant stars.
Look to the horizon.
But he said softly: "One day, you will set foot in the heavens, and we will naturally meet again!"
Wang Xian nodded.
The woman sighed faintly: "In the ten years here, the outside world is only ten days. Remember, don't tell anyone what happened during this time."
title_en: Chapter 11 Ten Years and Five Realms Chapter 12 Snow and Plum Blossoms
